encoderRules: Validate the neutral record without importing or executing the candidate in the builder workspace.

After both initial labels and any arbitration are locked, the custodian encoder resolves digest bindings, constructs each named Julia value in declared field order, and preserves every array member and its order.
The encoder may call only the construction and digest symbols allowed by C2_BUILDER_API_ALLOWLIST.json; it may not compile, detect, execute, audit, replay, or create a candidate receipt.
The runner receives only the resolved serialized ledger and artifact plus opaque operation metadata; neutral binding directives and gold fields are not serialized into candidate input.

admissionRules.constructorFailureBeforeSealDisposition: Mark the affected whole six-operation family ineligible and apply the preassigned whole-family mirror policy.

canonicalization.stableUnique: Retain first occurrence and encounter order.
canonicalization.reasonOrdering: FAIL: stableUnique(failures then gaps); UNRESOLVED: stableUnique(gaps); PASS: singleton pass reason.
canonicalization.witnessOrdering: Preserve every emission in evaluation order; never sort or deduplicate.
canonicalization.referenceIteration: stableUnique of artifact reference tuple after artifact-duplicate emission

digestDerivation.receipt: sha256(canonical_bytes((execution_receipt_v1, compiler_version, operator_version, operator_digest, rule_set_digest, ledger_digest, artifact_digest, traces, aggregate_action))) with sha256: prefix

locator.locatorTupleDuplicatePolicy: Do not deduplicate locator inputs. Re-evaluate each member in tuple order; repeated valid locators therefore repeat RULE_SATISFIED witnesses, while final reason and gap vectors still use stableUnique.
locator.documentTruthBoundary: Digest syntax only; external document authenticity is a builder premise.

originOracle.isolated: Exactly one non-router semantic vector differs from its clean seed; companion changes may not change another rule vector.
originOracle.compositional: Two or more non-router semantic vectors differ; the complete set is the gold origin set.

orderedEvaluation: Iterate primary_review.claims in one-based input order.
For each claim, call commonOracle.outputSpan on claim.output_span with artifact_path primary_review.claims[{claim_index}].
If proposition_ids is empty, emit CLAIM_PROPOSITION_REFERENCE_MISSING and continue to the next claim.
Otherwise, emit artifact-side PROPOSITION_REFERENCE_DUPLICATE once when the array contains a duplicate, then iterate stableUnique(proposition_ids).
For each proposition_id, evaluate match count, semantic status, and then commonOracle.locator in that order.

typedFindingConstructionGuard.hazard: An established false ledger policy adds its failure code after locator evaluation but emits no direct policy-value witness. If every other branch also emits zero witnesses, ValidationFindingV1 rejects the FAIL with INVALID_FAIL_FINDING before a receipt exists.
typedFindingConstructionGuard.eligibleGoldRequirement: Every sealed human-boundary FAIL vector must contain at least one witness from an artifact boundary violation, an explicit employment action, a locator branch that emits a witness, or another evaluated branch.
typedFindingConstructionGuard.presealDisposition: A neutral input that cannot satisfy this constructor invariant is not a FORMAL_INPUT_REFUSAL case; retire its whole family under the mirror policy before seal.

If no origin trace exists, return no finding and emit NOT_APPLICABLE.

Iterate every flattened item in one-based flattened order and call commonOracle.outputSpan using artifact_path primary_review.items[{flat_item_index}].
Only when failures and gaps are both empty, emit the bundle pass witness.
